def adjusted_winner(values, money):
    n_people = len(values)
    n_goods = len(values[0])
    
    # Initialize allocation
    allocation = [[] for _ in range(n_people)]
    money_allocation = [0] * n_people
    
    # Assign goods to the person who values them most
    for good in range(n_goods):
        max_value = max(values[person][good] for person in range(n_people))
        winner = [person for person in range(n_people) if values[person][good] == max_value][0]
        allocation[winner].append(good)
    
    # Calculate initial utilities
    utilities = [sum(values[i][good] for good in allocation[i]) for i in range(n_people)]
    
    # Adjust allocation to balance utilities
    while max(utilities) - min(utilities) > 1:
        winner = utilities.index(max(utilities))
        loser = utilities.index(min(utilities))
        
        if allocation[winner]:
            # Transfer the least valuable good from winner to loser
            good = min(allocation[winner], key=lambda g: values[winner][g])
            allocation[winner].remove(good)
            allocation[loser].append(good)
            utilities[winner] -= values[winner][good]
            utilities[loser] += values[loser][good]
        else:
            # Transfer money from winner to loser
            transfer = min(money_allocation[winner], (max(utilities) - min(utilities)) / 2)
            money_allocation[winner] -= transfer
            money_allocation[loser] += transfer
            utilities[winner] -= transfer
            utilities[loser] += transfer
    
    # Distribute remaining money equally
    remaining_money = money - sum(money_allocation)
    for i in range(n_people):
        money_allocation[i] += remaining_money / n_people
    
    return allocation, money_allocation
